# Kern overlay — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for Kern overlay when the moment needs a floating surface: one variant contract over modal, sheet, drawer, side-sheet, alert, tabbed dialog and dock. `variant` picks the surface, `size` the dialog width and `side` the edge for the side-sheet, while `trigger` is an element rendered as the trigger in the Base UI render model — composition rather than a second button. The tabbed dialog scaffolds through `tabs` with its own active-tab trio, so step and tab bodies ride the tab items and every tab keeps a resolving panel target; snap points with the snap index render the detented sheet and `footer` carries the footer actions. Escape always dismisses while scrim and outside-press dismissal are separately controlled by `dismissible` — and a blocking flow must use modal, because bottom sheets stay scrim-dismissible and the alert variant keeps the two-action law. `title` is required because every floating surface must be nameable, and focus stays inside while open through the composed primitives' trap. Popover, drawer, scroll-area and the menu and sheet families stay composed primitives: the overlay composes them and never re-implements them.

## Native

### Features

Reach for Kern overlay when the moment needs a floating surface: one variant contract over modal, sheet, drawer, side-sheet, alert, tabbed dialog and dock — the native twin under the same contract. `variant` picks the surface and `size` the modal width, with every modal variant rendering centred and sheets anchoring to the bottom edge; drawer and side-sheet converge onto the one bottom surface, because a phone has no usable edge panel and there is no `side` prop. The tabbed dialog scaffolds through `tabs` with its own active-tab trio, snap points drive real sheet detents, and the alert variant keeps the two-action law through the confirm and cancel expressions with `footer` carrying the footer actions. `title` is required because every floating surface must be nameable — it labels the trigger control and the surface alike — and scrim and back dismissal are platform-owned, always available rather than negotiated.
